version: V200.0 weight-programmed factual feedback foundation prototype
authority: User: first try writing from scratch a model with basic feedback processing ability, with generality.
question: Can a directly written task-independent neural memory controller use actual factual feedback to improve choices across several local task families, without gradient fitting or a pretrained checkpoint?
claim_scope: General interface and limited cross-task empirical reuse, NOT universal intelligence, a causal attribution engine, full world simulation, or a trained-baseline superiority claim.
construction: All parameter tensors are explicitly zeroed then assigned by analytic instructions before any experiment. No old checkpoints or task tables are read by the writer. The model receives context/action descriptors, explicit goals, observed factual outcomes and missingness masks, not an environment reward packet.
network: Two parameterized attention memories, parameterized discrepancy gate, bilinear fact-goal readout and uncertainty readout. Memory writes copy observed data only. The fixed feature lift includes a squared norm; this is disclosed architecture, not an inferred world law.
learning_meaning: Online experience changes model-owned memory state. Initial neural weights do not change during this first experiment. All weights remain trainable for a later genuine gradient-training comparison. No SLEEP or autonomous cause explanation is claimed.

interface.goal: public factual preferences, not a reward training target

evaluation: Each model acts from its own accumulated experience. The external evaluator retains hidden outcome means and a pre-generated common random tape, but neither enters the model. Choices for all variants use the same epsilon/tie random tape. First/last64 rounds and first/last32 after a change are reported; all seeds and failures retained. The delayed-credit case reports terminal success separately and is intended to expose absent multi-step attribution.
controls: No-history and random-untrained are mechanism controls only. Neither is a trained pure-feedback baseline; the requested future training comparison is NOT claimed complete.
preservation: New exclusive evidence directory; preserve first failure or partial, no automatic retry, no edits to executed source bytes, no old fixtures/learning/banks rerun. Only new engineering task instances, not a new formal science confirmation population. Existing V198/V199 results untouched.
adoption: This creates a standalone candidate checkpoint only. It is not installed in the previous learner or promoted to a general model on its own internal checks. No automation is created.
